independent_review.scope: Independent read-only verification of existing local build, image archive, scan, dependency inventory, test XML and runtime-smoke evidence. No builds, scans, Docker/AWS actions, source/docs changes or Git changes were performed by this review. Only this temporary JSON report was written.

scanner_comparison.execution_options: Parent executor reports same cache, offline/skip database updates, and no ignore/suppression. Report JSON and scan.log do not independently encode the complete invocation; reviewer did not re-run scanning.
scanner_comparison.comparison_limit: Controlled comparison against the same recorded database snapshot, not a scan using a newly refreshed database.

comparison.meaning: The four previously reported vulnerabilities are not detected in the newly built image, and corresponding packages are upgraded. This is not proof that all possible security vulnerabilities are absent.

dependency_verification.inventory_count_note: Gradle module coordinates and scanner package discovery are different inventories. All 17 Gradle-only coordinates are starter modules; five additional scanner-detected entries include jar mode tools and embedded packages. Counts must not be presented as identical coverage.
dependency_verification.build_test_codegen_classpaths: Their inventory is available, but image runtime vulnerability scanning does not certify separate build/test/code-generation classpath security.

source_identity.note: Only API README differs from the image source snapshot; runtime source/build/generated/test inputs remain matched.

completion_limits: Zero findings applies to the recorded image, Trivy version, database snapshot, and detected packages; it is not a general security certification.
Local runtime checks use a synthetic JWT issuer; actual Cognito login, AWS deployment and AWS incident scenarios were not verified.
PG16 test success is compatibility evidence only and does not change the jOOQ OSS 3.21 PostgreSQL 18 support boundary. A separate disposable PostgreSQL 18 environment was tested.
No ECR publication, GitHub CI result, production deployment approval or existing user database migration is established by this review.
